role: signature
notes: Nonlogical symbols with declared arities or sorts; governs text after a language declaration.

role: object-language variables
notes: Variables occurring in terms and formulas.

role: term metavariables
notes: Members of \(\mathrm{Term}(\mathcal L)\).

role: formula metavariables
notes: Members of the active formula set.  A source-bound presentation may instead declare its own formula metavariables locally; the source declaration governs that presentation.

role: object-language negation
notes: Primitive unary connective; prefix and governs the immediately following formula.

role: object-language conjunction
notes: Primitive or explicitly defined binary connective in the active language; left associative in handbook prose.

role: object-language disjunction
notes: Primitive or explicitly defined binary connective in the active language; left associative in handbook prose.

role: object-language implication
notes: Primitive or explicitly defined binary connective in the active language; right associative in handbook prose.

role: sentence metavariables
notes: Members of \(\mathrm{Sent}(\mathcal L)\).

role: universal quantifier
notes: Binds occurrences of x in its declared scope; prefix at the unary rank.

role: existential quantifier
notes: Binds occurrences of x in its declared scope; prefix at the unary rank.

role: simultaneous term substitutions
notes: Finite-support variable-to-term maps with declared action and composition.

role: formula contexts
notes: Finite sets, multisets, or sequences exactly as declared by the active calculus.  Source-bound locally typed uses such as the Buchi alphabet Sigma are recorded separately and are not contexts.

role: input and tape alphabets
notes: No formula-context standing in this scope.

role: finite words
notes: Finite words over the declared alphabet; later P4 chapters use the letters numerically.

role: syntactic arithmetic formula classes
notes: Classes fixed by the declared normalization and unbounded-quantifier alternation; P7.5 uses the same hierarchy in induction-fragment names.

role: arithmetical definability classes of relations
notes: Bold symbols classify relations definable in \(\mathcal N_{\mathrm{ar}}\), not formula strings or Borel pointclasses.

role: ordinal metavariables
notes: Ordinals of the ambient set theory; recurs under a local declaration in P7.5 ordinal analysis; disjoint from the type-metavariable scope.

role: type metavariables
notes: Scope is disjoint from the P7.5 ordinal role and the P7.6 finite-type role.

role: theories
notes: Sets of sentences in the fixed signature.

role: structures
notes: Structures for the active signature with nonempty domains unless locally declared otherwise; in exact Part V, \(\mathcal N\) is the standard structure for the fixed arithmetic signature.

role: domain operator
notes: Editorial domain notation; operand type fixes structure, function or name domains. A source presentation may retain its own explicitly typed domain notation.

role: valuation
notes: Map from propositional variables to the active truth-value set in propositional and finite-matrix semantics; its homomorphic extension \(\widehat v\) is fixed by the active semantics.

role: variable assignment
notes: Map from first-order variables to \(\operatorname{dom}\mathcal M\).

role: satisfaction
notes: \(\varphi\) is satisfied by \(\mathcal M\) under \(s\).

role: truth in a structure
notes: Sentence \(\sigma\) is true in \(\mathcal M\).

role: semantic consequence
notes: Every interpretation and assignment in the declared class satisfying \(\Gamma\) satisfies \(\varphi\).

role: derivability (per-system turnstile)
notes: A derivation exists in the named calculus \(S\); the subscript is mandatory outside a declared local abbreviation.

role: editorial formula equivalence
notes: Metalinguistic equivalence in presentations declaring this notation. Source-local formula equivalence written with \(\equiv\) is retained and registered separately.

role: object-language biconditional
notes: Object-language constructor; rank 7 of the extended precedence ladder.

role: definitional abbreviation
notes: The left expression is defined by the right expression; this sign is metalinguistic.

role: capture-avoiding substitution
notes: Substitution of \(t\) for free occurrences of \(x\) in \(\varphi\).

role: free-variable operation
notes: Variables with a free occurrence in the locally declared formula, context, term, or type syntax; context action takes the union over members.

role: model class
notes: Structures satisfying every sentence of \(T\).

role: theory of a structure
notes: Sentences true in \(\mathcal M\).

role: finite iteration or closure
notes: For an alphabet this is finite-word Kleene star; for a relation it is reflexive-transitive closure. Operand type fixes the reading.

role: falsum and verum or declared CLL nullary units
notes: Outside the P8.6 CLL grammar these are bottom and the defined top abbreviation; in that grammar \(\bot\) is the par unit and \(\top\) is the with unit, with the ambient syntax fixing the role.

role: set of natural numbers
notes: Contains 0 under the Part-1 natural-number convention.

role: power set
notes: Set of all subsets of the set A; set existence comes from the ambient foundation.

role: cardinality
notes: Cardinality for set operands. Source-local uses for domains or symbolic length require their own explicit type and scope; the editorial domain form is \(\operatorname{dom}\).

role: elementary equivalence of structures
notes: The structures satisfy the same sentences. Structure operands distinguish this role from declared source-local formula equivalence.

role: elementary substructure
notes: Every formula with parameters from \(\mathcal M\) has the same truth value in \(\mathcal M\) and \(\mathcal N\).

role: atomic diagram
notes: Atomic sentences with parameters true in \(\mathcal M\).

role: elementary diagram
notes: All parameter sentences true in \(\mathcal M\).

role: type space
notes: Complete \(n\)-types consistent with \(T\) under the clopen topology.

role: ultraproduct
notes: Quotient of the direct product by equality on a set in the ultrafilter \(\mathcal U\).

role: isomorphism
notes: Structure-preserving bijection; \(\simeq\) remains separately reserved for Kleene equality.

role: Kleene equality
notes: Both sides are defined with equal value or both are undefined.

role: many-one reducibility
notes: A total computable translator preserves membership.

role: Turing reducibility
notes: An oracle machine for the right-hand set decides the left-hand set.

role: partial computable function with index e
notes: Oracle form \(\varphi^B_e\) is relative to \(B\); finite-string form \(\varphi_e^\tau\) and stage form \(\varphi^{B_s}_{e,s}\) are defined in the two priority proofs.

role: Turing jump
notes: Postfix prime on an oracle set.

role: iterated jump of the empty set
notes: First defined with the general jump iteration.

role: Goedel number
notes: Corner quotes around an expression denote its fixed effective code.

role: numeral
notes: Closed arithmetic term \(S^n0\). In the P5 representation construction, barred argument lists are typed tuples; an overline applied componentwise gives their numeral terms.

role: proof predicate
notes: First the explicitly checked numerical relation on certified proof codes; def:fixed-proof-predicate then uses the same notation for a chosen \(\Sigma^0_1\) formula numeralwise representing that relation in \(\mathsf Q\). Numerical correctness alone does not establish internal derivability conditions for that formula.

role: provability predicate
notes: For the earlier certified presentation this abbreviates \(\exists p\,\mathsf{Proof}_T(p,x)\). The later derivability and consistency chapter explicitly declares its chosen formula parameter; its internal hypotheses concern that choice. Arguments are formula codes.

role: selected standard PA provability predicate
notes: In the second-incompleteness chapter this is explicitly the literal selected \(\mathsf{Prv}^{19}_{\PA}\). The GL realization writes that selected formula directly. No internal identification with the earlier arbitrary numeralwise representative is assumed.

role: metalinguistic primitive-recursive proof relations and negation-code function
notes: Relations and function on natural-number codes used before choosing object-language representatives; none is a term or predicate of the fixed arithmetic language.

role: Rosser proof formula
notes: A fixed Sigma-zero-one formula numeralwise representing the primitive-recursive Rosser proof relation.

role: Rosser provability predicate
notes: A proof of the coded sentence exists whose code is strictly smaller than every proof code for its negation; distinct from ordinary provability.

role: consistency sentence
notes: Abbreviates \(\neg\mathsf{Prov}_T(\overline{\ulcorner\bottom_A\urcorner})\) for the specified formula parameter. Standard PA uses the selected tag-19 existential graph; P7 names its theory argument explicitly.

role: presentation-indexed consistency sentence
notes: Exposes the proof formula. It equals \(\mathsf{Con}(T)\) when the chosen provability formula is the existential closure of that proof formula. Standard PA uses the selected tag-19 pair; a certified representative retains its own indexed sentence.

role: cumulative-hierarchy level
notes: \(V=\bigcup_\alpha V_\alpha\) is class notation, registered with its level notation.

role: set-theoretic rank
notes: Least \(\alpha\) with \(x\subseteq V_\alpha\).

role: constructible level
notes: The \(\alpha\)-th level of the constructible hierarchy.

role: forcing poset
notes: \(q\leq p\) reads \(q\) is stronger, per the fixed forcing convention.

role: class of P-names
notes: Name metavariables \(\nu\) range over \(M\cap V^{\mathbb P}\).

role: check name
notes: Canonical forcing name of a ground-model set.

role: name evaluation
notes: Interpretation by the generic filter \(G\) of a locally declared forcing name \(\nu,\nu_f\), or \(\zeta\).

role: generic extension
notes: The forcing extension obtained by adjoining the \(M\)-generic filter \(G\).

role: semantic set-theoretic forcing
notes: Exact external relation: every M-generic filter containing p yields an extension satisfying the formula at the interpreted names.

role: imported recursive forcing assertion
notes: Formula-by-formula recursive assertion imported by the cited forcing theorem; equivalent there to the separately registered semantic relation. Bare \(p\Vdash\varphi\) is its local abbreviation only under the renewed ccc/name-counting convention.

role: sequent
notes: Metalevel punctuation between antecedent and succedent contexts.

role: full second-order consequence
notes: Consequence over full standard structures.

role: Henkin consequence
notes: Consequence over Henkin structures.

role: least epsilon ordinal
notes: Least fixed point of ordinal exponentiation base \(\omega\); calibrates PA in P7.5.

role: canonical ordering
notes: Ambient order on declared numerical and order-theoretic objects; P4.3 is excluded because bare \(\leq\) there is object-language arithmetic syntax.

role: object-language arithmetic order abbreviation
notes: Eliminable abbreviation \(r\leq t\defeq\exists z\,(z+r=t)\), with the least variable fresh for the displayed terms; marked bounded quantifiers inherit it.

role: canonical ordering
notes: Ambient order on degrees, natural numbers, and resource bounds; not arithmetic object-language syntax.

role: object-language arithmetic order abbreviation
notes: The P4.3 abbreviation imported for the Q and Rosser chapters.

role: canonical ordering
notes: Ambient order on declared numerical and order-theoretic objects, including ordinals, cardinals, degrees, and frame orders.

role: metalinguistic natural-number order
notes: Used where bare \(\leq\) simultaneously denotes arithmetic-language syntax; operands are standard naturals or codes, never arithmetic terms.

role: canonical strict ordering
notes: Ambient strict order on declared numerical and order-theoretic objects; P4.3 is excluded because bare \(<\) there is object-language arithmetic syntax.

role: object-language arithmetic strict-order abbreviation
notes: Eliminable abbreviation \(r<t\defeq\exists z\,(r+Sz=t)\), with the least variable fresh for the displayed terms.

role: canonical strict ordering
notes: Ambient strict order on declared numerical and order-theoretic objects; not arithmetic object-language syntax.

role: metalinguistic natural-number strict order
notes: Used where bare \(<\) simultaneously denotes arithmetic-language syntax; operands are standard naturals or codes, never arithmetic terms.

role: strict ordering
notes: Contract list; strict dual of \(\leq\); ``positive'' means \(>0\) by the natural-numbers convention.

role: Kripke forcing
notes: The negated partner is \(\nVdash\) (macro \texttt{\detokenize{\nforces}}); modal satisfaction continues to use \(\models\).

role: necessity operator
notes: Prefix unary at the negation rank; modal and provability readings are fixed by the active system.

role: Anderson--Belnap relevance abbreviation
notes: Exact eliminable abbreviation \((A\to A)\to A\) on the E and R sheets; it is not a primitive modality.

role: possibility operator
notes: Prefix unary at the negation rank; \(\neg\Box\neg\) where defined.

role: temporal next
notes: Prefix unary at the negation rank.

role: temporal until
notes: Binds tighter than every binary connective and looser than the unary rank; licenses the U-unfolding axiom's written form.

role: temporal eventually
notes: Defined \(\mathsf FA:\equiv\top\mathbin{\mathsf U}A\), prefix unary at the negation rank.

role: temporal always
notes: Defined \(\mathsf GA:\equiv\neg\mathsf F\neg A\), prefix unary at the negation rank.

role: knowledge operator (agent i)
notes: Prefix unary at the negation rank.

role: epistemic accessibility
notes: Agent-indexed accessibility; an equivalence relation for knowledge readings.

role: mutual knowledge
notes: \(E_GA:\equiv\bigwedge_{i\in G}K_iA\), prefix unary at the negation rank.

role: common knowledge
notes: Prefix unary at the negation rank; satisfaction via reflexive-transitive reachability under the union of the \(\sim_i\).

role: linear tensor and its homomorphic semantic interpretation
notes: Formula operands give the exact IMLL or CLL connective; the IMLL algebra and CLL phase clauses interpret that same connective with their source-standard tensor operation.

role: linear implication and its residual interpretation
notes: Formula operands give IMLL or CLL linear implication; the algebraic and phase clauses interpret that same connective by the source-standard residual.

role: multiplicative unit
notes: Syntactic tensor unit in IMLL and CLL; the ambient calculus distinguishes it from a semantic monoid identity.

role: bang exponential and its phase interpretation
notes: Prefix connective on the source-bounded IMLL extension and full CLL; the phase clause for \(!F\) interprets that same connective, and neither use is factorial.

role: set of worlds
notes: Nonempty world carrier for intuitionistic, modal, temporal, epistemic, and broad Routley--Meyer semantics; world letters are declared locally.

role: binary accessibility relation
notes: Frame relation of modal, temporal, and epistemic structures; scope is disjoint from the P8.6 ternary relation.

role: normal worlds
notes: Nonempty distinguished subset of the broad inherited Routley--Meyer structure fixing its source-scoped validity notion.

role: ternary accessibility relation
notes: Ternary relation in broad and matched Routley--Meyer structures; scope is disjoint from binary accessibility.

role: Routley star
notes: Postfix unary operation on relevance worlds used by the negation clause; distinct from closure stars and the extension marker in \(\mathsf L^*\).

role: matrix value set
notes: Finite nonempty truth-value set for the generic matrix sheet; distinct from world valuation \(V\) and cumulative \(V_\alpha\).

role: designated values
notes: Subset of the active matrix value set fixing matrix consequence.

role: matrix operation for connective c
notes: Total n-ary operation on \(\mathsf V\) interpreting the declared connective \(c\).

role: semantic consequence (per-system turnstile)
notes: The subscript names the semantics (\(\models_{\mathcal M}\) matrix, \(\models_{\mathrm{K3}}\), \(\models_{\mathrm{LP}}\), \(\models_{\mathsf{S4}}\), ...).

role: local modal consequence
notes: Truth preservation at one world in the declared modal or epistemic frame class.

role: global modal consequence
notes: Truth preservation at all worlds in the declared modal or epistemic frame class.

role: satisfaction at a world
notes: Satisfaction at world \(w\) of the structure \(\mathcal M\).

role: default formula metavariables in inherited Part-8 prose
notes: Default only where the inherited or cited presentation uses these letters.  A named source presentation's own locally declared syntax overrides this row; this row never licenses renaming source metavariables.

role: residuated pomonoid datum
notes: The inherited source tuple.  Within its definition A is locally typed as the algebra carrier, overriding the default formula-metavariable role.

role: world valuation
notes: \(V:\mathsf{Prop}\to\mathcal P(W)\) (temporal structures: \(V:\mathbb N\to\mathcal P(\mathsf{Prop})\)); distinct from matrix \(\mathsf V\) and cumulative \(V_\alpha\).

role: valuation satisfaction
notes: The valuation's homomorphic extension designates \(\varphi\).

role: model of a theory
notes: \(\mathcal M\) satisfies every member of \(T\).

role: set of propositional variables
notes: Exactly \(\{p_n:n\in\mathbb N\}\) in the fixed countable CPL language.

role: default propositional-atom set
notes: Used where the inherited or cited presentation declares this atom-set glyph.  A named source presentation may instead declare its own atom notation, which governs locally without house renaming.

role: object-language propositional variables
notes: \(p_n\) is the indexed variable schema; uppercase letters denote specified members of \(\mathsf{Prop}\) in examples and diagrams, never formula metavariables.

role: set of CPL formulas
notes: Least set generated by the declared propositional grammar.

role: source CPL truth-value set
notes: The active source defines \(\{\mathbf F,\mathbf T\}\). Numerical Boolean valuations use the explicit coding \(\mathbf F\mapsto0\) and \(\mathbf T\mapsto1\); this is not literal equality of the two sets.

role: source CPL truth values
notes: False and true in the inherited recursive valuation clauses and the semantic substitution/replacement theorems.

role: source CPL semantic formula equivalence
notes: Every source CPL valuation gives the formulas the same truth value; active in sec:prop-syntax-semantics-02 and sec:p02-propositional-substitution. It is a metalinguistic relation, not an object-language connective.

role: formula complexity
notes: Recursively counts constructor occurrences under the active propositional or first-order grammar.

role: subformula-set operation
notes: Set of subformulas fixed by the recursive CPL definition.

role: uniform propositional substitution
notes: A metalinguistic map \(\mathsf{Prop}\to\mathsf{Fm}_{\mathsf{CPL}}\); not the globally registered sentence metavariables \(\sigma,\tau\).

role: uniform-substitution instance
notes: Recursive action of the declared uniform substitution on a CPL formula.

role: formula occurrence-position set
notes: Finite parse-tree addresses over \(\{1,2\}\), defined in def:p02-selected-replacement; occurrences are distinct even when their subformula strings agree.

role: subformula at a selected position
notes: The subformula rooted at \(a\in\operatorname{Pos}(\varphi)\); the address is in the original formula tree.

role: simultaneous selected-occurrence replacement
notes: Replaces the chosen original occurrences in \(O\) by \(\chi\), with the exact admissibility conditions of def:p02-selected-replacement; inserted copies are not searched again.

role: empty occurrence address
notes: The empty word over \(\{1,2\}\) denotes the root position in def:p02-selected-replacement; this is not an epsilon binder or an ordinal.

role: literal complement
notes: Metalinguistic involution exchanging \(p_n\) and \(\neg p_n\); P7.8 reuses it on the extended-resolution sheet; disjoint from numeral bars.

role: propositional-literal ordering code
notes: \(\operatorname{code}(p_n)=2n\) and \(\operatorname{code}(\neg p_n)=2n+1\); fixes one formula string for each clause.

role: formula interpretation of a clause
notes: Increasing-code disjunction of a finite clause; the empty clause maps to falsum.

role: NNF dual operation
notes: Metalinguistic involution fixing literals and exchanging conjunction with disjunction and falsum with verum.

role: complemented valuation
notes: For the explicitly numerical Boolean presentation, \(\bar v(p)=1-v(p)\); with source-labelled values the same complement swaps \(\mathbf F\) and \(\mathbf T\). Used in propositional duality.

role: clone generated by truth functions
notes: Intersection of all positive-arity Boolean clones containing C.

role: Post maximal clones
notes: Respectively 0-preserving, 1-preserving, monotone, affine, and self-dual positive-arity Boolean functions.

role: two-element field
notes: Field used for affine Boolean functions and XOR constraints.

role: metalinguistic Boolean operator names
notes: Formula abbreviations for negated conjunction and negated disjunction; not active binary glyphs.

role: CPL calculus identifiers
notes: Names the registered natural-deduction sequent and Hilbert calculi; derivability still carries the calculus as a turnstile subscript.

role: support of a finite multiset
notes: Formulas having positive multiplicity in the declared propositional or first-order finite-multiset context; reused in P7.1.

role: full-language-to-Hilbert translation
notes: Metalinguistic recursive map into the negation-implication fragment; avoids the globally reserved sentence metavariable \(\tau\).

role: deterministic polynomial-time language class
notes: Local propositional-complexity standing.

role: nondeterministic polynomial-time language class
notes: Equivalently polynomially witnessed languages under the declared encoding; reused in P4.6 P7.8 and the P12.1 proof-certificate comparison.

role: complements of NP languages
notes: Decision-language class under the declared encoding; reused in P4.6 and P7.8.

role: satisfiable propositional encodings
notes: Malformed strings are excluded by the local encoding convention.

role: valid propositional encodings
notes: Malformed strings are excluded by the fixed encoding convention; reused in P4.6 and P7.8.

role: first-order variable alphabet
notes: The fixed countably infinite object-language variable set; distinct from the occurrence-set operator \(\operatorname{Var}\).

role: function- and relation-symbol sets
notes: The disjoint nonlogical-symbol families of a first-order signature; constants are zero-ary function symbols.

role: signature arity maps
notes: Maps the function- and relation-symbol families to their finite arities.

role: first-order term formula and sentence sets
notes: Least syntactic sets generated by the active first-order grammar; sentences are formulas with no free variables.

role: occurring-variable set
notes: All variables occurring in the declared term, formula, literal, clause, or finite clause set \(e\), whether free or bound; for a finite clause set the operator is the union of the occurrence sets of its clauses.

role: alpha-equivalence
notes: Least constructor congruence generated by capture-avoiding bound-variable renaming; distinct from identity formula equivalence and elementary equivalence.

role: assignment update
notes: Agrees with assignment \(s\) except that variable \(x\) is sent to \(a\).

role: term value
notes: Recursive denotation of the first-order term \(t\) in structure \(\mathcal M\) under assignment \(s\).

role: restriction or reduct operator
notes: Operand types distinguish function or set restriction, a structure reduct, and the P8.3 public-announcement submodel induced by the surviving worlds.

role: semantic consequence closure
notes: Sentences of the active signature semantically entailed by theory \(T\).

role: at-least-n sentence
notes: The first-order sentence asserting the existence of \(n\) pairwise distinct elements.

role: definitional-extension signature and axiom
notes: The signature obtained by adjoining relation symbol \(R\) and its exact defining biconditional axiom.

role: relation defined by a formula in a structure
notes: The tuple relation cut out by \(\varphi\) in \(\mathcal M\); deliberately not \(R^*\), which is reserved for reflexive-transitive closure.

role: first-order calculus identifiers
notes: Names the registered natural-deduction sequent and equality-free Hilbert presentations; canonical LK recurs in P7 and the P8.1 negative-translation statements; turnstiles retain exact subscripts.

role: active tableau signatures
notes: The finite root subsignature and its countable fresh-parameter expansion used by the fair first-order tableau construction.

role: positive atomic branch and tableau countermodel
notes: The positive ground atoms on a fair saturated branch and the induced active-language Herbrand structure.

role: Herbrand structure determined by ground atoms
notes: Ground-term structure whose positive relation atoms are exactly the members of the declared Herbrand-base subset \(B\).

role: first-order NNF translations
notes: Simultaneously recursive maps equivalent to \(\varphi\) and \(\neg\varphi\), respectively.

role: rectification and prenex maps
notes: Metalinguistic constructions; the forbidden-variable parameter belongs only to rectification.

role: Skolem form
notes: Universal Skolem sentence in the expanded signature; equisatisfiability and reduct directions retain their separate choice standing.

role: clause formula and universal closure
notes: Fixed literal-order disjunction for clause \(C\) and its universal closure over every occurring variable.

role: variable support of a term substitution
notes: Variables not fixed by \(\theta\); the subscript prevents collision with finite-multiset support.

role: simultaneous substitution action and composition
notes: Action extends homomorphically and composition satisfies \((\theta\eta)(x)=(\theta(x))\eta\).

role: substitution instance preorder
notes: Every instance of \(\rho\) is an instance of \(\theta\); equivalently \(\rho=\theta\eta\) for some substitution \(\eta\).

role: unification equation
notes: Metalinguistic equation constraint processed by unification; not object-language identity.

role: Henkin witness implication
notes: Metalinguistic abbreviation for \(\exists x\,\varphi\to\varphi[c/x]\) with fresh constant \(c\).

role: Henkin constant expansion
notes: Signature obtained by adjoining the fresh constants used by the Henkin witness construction.

role: Henkin quotient-model notation
notes: Provable-equality relation term class quotient term structure and canonical variable assignment for a maximal consistent witness set \(\Delta\).

role: parameter signature and canonical expansion
notes: Adds one constant for each domain element and interprets every such constant by the element it names.

role: subscripted alias for the standard first-order arithmetic structure
notes: Earlier separately authored material uses this explicit subscript; exact inherited Part V writes \(\mathcal N\) for the same structure in the fixed arithmetic signature.

role: decidable first-order fragment identifiers
notes: Respectively the two-variable relational fragment guarded relational fragment and Bernays--Schoenfinkel effectively propositional class; equality and function scopes are row-local.

role: decision-problem complexity classes
notes: Every bound applies only to the named decision problem.

role: finite quantifier-block pattern
notes: A finite existential block followed by a finite universal block; stars are metalinguistic repetition rather than object-language operators.

role: real ordered field
notes: The ordinary field of real numbers; the P2.3 categoricity claim names its ordered-field structure.

role: rational ordered field
notes: The ordinary field of rational numbers; used as an order type in P5 and as the scalar domain of linear rational arithmetic in P12.2.

role: relational second-order signature and variable stocks
notes: For every positive n the second component is the countably infinite stock of n-ary relation variables.

role: relation-variable metavariables
notes: Superscripts record arity; Y and F carry freshness conditions and U is an admissible relation-variable or predicate-constant instance.

role: predicate-constant metavariable
notes: An n-ary nonlogical predicate constant in the active relational second-order signature.

role: capture-avoiding relation-variable substitution
notes: Metalinguistic substitution of a relation variable or predicate constant of the same arity; distinct from term substitution.

role: finite full second-order Peano sentence
notes: Definition def:p02-pa2 packages the three successor/induction axioms and four arithmetic recursion axioms into one closed sentence in the expanded signature; the corresponding finite axiom set has the same full models.

role: effective calculus metavariable
notes: A calculus whose finite derivations are computably checkable; local to the non-enumerability theorem.

role: relational Henkin structure and relation domains
notes: The object domain is M and each nonempty relation domain is a selected subset of the corresponding powerset.

role: matched comprehension-choice Henkin model class
notes: Models satisfy exactly the eligible comprehension and graph-choice schemas; distinct from arbitrary Henkin structures.

role: matched second-order schema abbreviations
notes: Metalinguistic names for the universally closed eligible formulas displayed on sheet:sol.

role: matched Henkin consequence
notes: Truth preservation over exactly the matched comprehension-choice Henkin model class and matching assignments.

role: formula-level universal closure
notes: Universally closes exactly the displayed free object and relation parameters; distinct from the clause-language subscripted closure.

role: incidence-translation signature data
notes: \(D\) is the object sort; \(S_n\) the n-ary relation sort; \(E_n\) incidence; and \(\widehat P\) the relation-sort constant representing predicate \(P\).

role: incidence translation on formulas contexts structures and assignments
notes: A metalinguistic tagging and translation operation; the operand determines its eliminable clause.

role: translated matched-schema theory
notes: The many-sorted first-order translations of exactly all eligible comprehension and graph-choice instances.

role: translation-defined calculus identifiers
notes: Eliminable metalinguistic derivability abbreviations; neither names an independently generated native rule set.

role: second-order reachability formula
notes: The full-semantic closure formula for finite directed reachability; its Henkin converse can fail.

role: type metavariables
notes: Local to the simple-type grammar; disjoint from ordinal metavariables and the separate P7.4 type scope.

role: individual and truth-value base types
notes: Base types of the representative simple type theory; iota here is a type and not the P2.4 description binder.

role: object-language function-type former
notes: Right-associative type constructor in the active typed calculus; distinct from object-language implication.

role: typed-term metavariables
notes: Used only under local type declarations in P2.3; disjoint from P8 formula metavariables and algebraic carriers.

role: type ascription
notes: The active typed calculus fixes the displayed term and type categories; distinct from the P7.7 labelled-formula colon.

role: typed lambda abstraction
notes: Object-language term former binding x in the displayed body; used by STLC System F and System T with capture-avoiding substitution.

role: typed equality and universal-quantifier constants
notes: Object-language typed constants; Eq-alpha is deliberately distinct from global metalinguistic alpha-equivalence.

role: semantic domain at type alpha
notes: Nonempty type domain; standard function types contain all functions and Henkin domains may select a closure-stable subset.

role: typed-term denotation
notes: Recursive semantic value of a well-typed term under typed assignment s.

role: capture-avoiding typed substitution
notes: Substitutes the typed term A for free occurrences of x in B after the required alpha-renaming.

role: auxiliary translated structure
notes: A one-sorted or strict many-sorted model in the translation proofs; scope is disjoint from P8 algebraic structures.

role: extensional-collapse map and induced assignment
notes: Maps a relation-sort object to its n-ary extension and transports relation-variable assignments through that map.

role: strict many-sorted signature data
notes: The nonempty sort set and symbol-typing map determine the strict many-sorted language.

role: sort metavariables sorted variables and carriers
notes: Sans-serif sort letters avoid the canonical assignment s; strict carriers are nonempty and pairwise disjoint.

role: one-sorted reduct signature and sort predicates
notes: The flat signature forgets type declarations and \(Q_{\mathsf s}\) cuts out the component for sort \(\mathsf s\).

role: many-sorted guard translation and sort theory

glyph: \(\mathsf P_{\bowtie q}[\psi],\mathsf P^{\min}_{\bowtie q}[\psi],\mathsf P^{\max}_{\bowtie q}[\psi]\)
macro: \mathsf P_{\bowtie q},\mathsf P^{\min}_{\bowtie q},\mathsf P^{\max}_{\bowtie q}
role: probability-threshold modalities
notes: The undecorated form uses the active DTMC or CTMC path measure; min and max forms take the MDP infimum and supremum over the declared scheduler class.

role: bounded-step and real-time temporal operators
notes: The first bounds DTMC or MDP steps by natural k; X-I tests the first CTMC transition time and U-I bounds elapsed time by a declared real interval I.

role: finite CTMC rates embedded jumps and timed paths
notes: The nonnegative rational rate map is typed on all state pairs and may contain positive self-loops; E sums the full row P is R divided by E at nonabsorbing states and tau-i is the residence time before path position i-plus-one. Pi-at-t uses the locally stated endpoint convention.

role: CSL long-run threshold modality
notes: Compares the starting-state-dependent limiting probability of Phi-states with q; not the temporal since connective.

role: atemporal probability structure and likelihood term
notes: Mu is the event measure and w-phi its value on the phi-event; pi is locally the world-valuation map and not the temporal path metavariable.

role: propositional dynamic logic and calculus identifier
notes: The regular-program modal system whose exact grammar semantics and Hilbert sheet are registered in Part IX.

role: PDL program constructors
notes: Relational composition choice reflexive-transitive closure and identity test in the mutually generated PDL grammar.

role: PDL universal program modality
notes: True when every alpha-successor satisfies A; the index is a regular program rather than a modal frame label.

role: PDL theoremhood judgment
notes: Finite no-premise derivability on sheet:hilbert-pdl.

role: Hoare partial or total correctness triple
notes: The active correctness tag determines whether termination is required; braces do not denote sets in this role.

role: deterministic while-language big-step evaluation
notes: Least evaluation relation from a command and initial integer state to a terminating final state.

role: weakest and weakest liberal preconditions
notes: Predicate transformers distinguished by whether termination is required.

role: partial and total Hoare derivability tags
notes: Judgments on sheet:hoare-while; only the total tag licenses the decreasing-variant loop rule.

role: disjoint finite heaps and their union
notes: Perpendicular denotes disjoint domains and uplus the defined union of compatible finite partial heaps.

role: separating conjunction
notes: Assertion connective splitting one heap into disjoint subheaps satisfying P and Q; distinct from ordinary conjunction and arithmetic multiplication.

role: Herbrand base immediate-consequence map and least model
notes: HB-P is a set of ground atoms T-P is its monotone consequence operator and M-P is the least fixed point.

role: SLD goal
notes: Finite ordered goal sequence; an empty sequence is refutation success rather than a clause with an omitted head.

role: SLD transition labelled by an mgu
notes: Applies the displayed most general unifier to the entire resolvent on sheet:sld-resolution.

role: logic-programming default negation
notes: Ground operational negation by finite failure in SLDNF; not classical object-language negation.

role: Clark completion of a normal program
notes: Predicate-defining biconditionals plus the explicitly stated signature-relative free-term equality axioms; distinct from least and stable models.

role: Gelfond-Lifschitz reduct
notes: Positive program obtained relative to atom set M by deleting defeated rules and remaining default-negated literals.

role: stable operator and well-founded approximation bounds
notes: Gamma-P maps M to the least model of P-superscript-M; L and G are the least and greatest fixed points of its square.

role: conjunctive query and canonical database
notes: The canonical finite structure D-q carries the query variables constants atoms and distinguished free tuple.

role: conjunctive-query containment
notes: Every answer to q1 is an answer to q2 on every finite database; distinct from set inclusion inside one instance.

role: fixed-template constraint-satisfaction problem
notes: B is the fixed finite relational target and the input asks for a homomorphism from A to B.

role: QBF reduction transition equality and selector formulas
notes: Metalinguistic polynomial-size Boolean formulas on configuration blocks; the selector permits one textual recursive occurrence.

role: bounded configuration-reachability QBF family
notes: True exactly when v is reachable from u within two-to-the-i steps; a metalinguistic formula family rather than a new object-language predicate.

role: initial and canonical accepting configuration blocks
notes: Boolean constant blocks substituted into the final closed QBF; not first-order individual constants.

role: closed QBF produced by the PSPACE reduction
notes: The polynomial-size formula R-m applied to the initial and canonical accepting configuration blocks.

role: product space of regular cardinals
notes: Functions with f(kappa) below kappa at every coordinate in the nonempty set a; the cardinality of this space is the cardinal product.

role: equality and comparison modulo a filter
notes: The set of coordinates satisfying the indicated comparison belongs to D; for an ultrafilter the quotient order is linear.

role: possible cofinalities of a product
notes: Cofinalities of the ultrafilter quotients of the product of the infinite regular cardinals in a; principal ultrafilters are included.

role: fourth uncountable initial ordinal
notes: Initial ordinal of cardinality aleph-four; used as the aleph index in Shelah's bound at aleph-omega.

role: NNF complement of an ALC concept
notes: The recursive involution complements literals and constants and exchanges Boolean and modal duals; its extension is the complement in the interpretation domain.

role: ALC input closure and its cardinality
notes: Finite set of normalized input concepts their sub-concepts and NNF complements; m is linear in the total input length.

role: complete ALC concept type and realized type
notes: A type is a subset of the fixed closure satisfying Boolean completeness and every internalized GCI; the realized type records truth at x in I.

role: role compatibility of ALC types
notes: Every universal r-restriction in t has its filler in u; this relation supplies all role edges in the canonical model.

role: surviving ALC type sets
notes: S-zero contains all complete types; each stage removes types lacking existential witnesses; S is the stable survivor set.

role: configuration concept names in the ALC hardness reduction
notes: Unary concept names record machine control head position and one tape symbol per cell; their extensions are constrained by finite general inclusions.

role: binary countdown concepts in the ALC hardness reduction
notes: B-ell records one rank bit; Z and L-ell abbreviate conjunctions saying all bits or all lower bits are zero.

role: nonnegative rank of an ALC reduction model element
notes: Integer obtained from the concept-membership bits at x; every transition role edge decreases this value by exactly one.

role: ALC concept and TBox encoding alternating acceptance
notes: The concept fixes the input configuration and maximal binary rank; the finite TBox enforces configurations branching transitions and countdown.

role: term algebra on a generator set
notes: Finite terms over the finitary signature tau and variables X; a nonempty algebra only when variables or nullary symbols exist.

role: evaluation of an algebraic term
notes: Term value in A under the variable assignment v; every assignment extends uniquely to a term-algebra homomorphism.

role: simultaneous algebraic term substitution
notes: The map on variables extends homomorphically to terms; the extension may have a different generator alphabet as codomain.

role: universal identity consequence
notes: Every nonempty algebra validating all premise identities under all valuations validates the conclusion identity under all valuations.

role: finite equational derivability
notes: Derivability from identity premises by the complete registered reflexivity symmetry transitivity compatibility and substitution rules.

role: congruence of provable identities
notes: The least fully invariant congruence on the nonempty term algebra containing all premise equation pairs.

role: free algebra and its generator map
notes: The map from X has a unique homomorphic extension into every member of the variety; it need not be injective in a trivial variety.

role: semantic congruence defining a relative free algebra
notes: Two X-terms are related exactly when all evaluations into all algebras of the variety identify them.

role: congruence lattice and its bounds
notes: Congruences ordered by inclusion; Delta is equality and nabla is the universal relation; meets are intersections.

role: principal congruence generated by a pair
notes: Intersection of every congruence on A containing the pair (a,b).

role: kernel congruence of an algebra homomorphism
notes: Pairs of domain elements with equal h-images; the kernel of a product map is the intersection of its coordinate kernels.

role: quotient congruence above a kernel
notes: For theta contained in phi this relation on A/theta relates exactly the classes of phi-related representatives.

role: monolith of a nontrivial algebra
notes: Least congruence strictly above equality when it exists; this condition characterizes nontrivial subdirect irreducibility.

role: maximal congruence separating a chosen pair
notes: Maximal among congruences omitting (a,b); the quotient is subdirectly irreducible and still separates the chosen elements.

role: Boolean filter generated by adjoining one element
notes: Elements above f meet a for some f in F; used in ultrafilter dichotomy and avoiding-element extension.

role: Stone space and its basic clopen sets
notes: X-B consists of the ultrafilters of B; hat-a consists of those containing a; trivial B gives the empty space.

role: Boolean algebra of clopen subsets
notes: Intersection union and relative complement act on the clopens of X; the bounds are the empty set and X.

role: Boolean representation isomorphism
notes: Maps a Boolean element a to its basic clopen hat-a in the Stone space X-B.

role: Stone-space reconstruction homeomorphism
notes: Maps x to the ultrafilter of all clopen subsets containing x.

role: continuous dual of a Boolean homomorphism
notes: For h from B to C sends an ultrafilter of C to its inverse image under h, an ultrafilter of B.

role: Boolean dual of a continuous map
notes: For g from X to Y sends a clopen subset of Y to its inverse image in X.

role: categories in Stone duality
notes: Boolean algebras with homomorphisms preserving both bounds; compact Hausdorff spaces with clopen bases and continuous maps; trivial and empty objects are allowed.

role: Cantor space of binary sequences
notes: The countable product of the discrete two-element space with coordinates starting at zero.

role: binary cylinder and length-n initial segment
notes: The cylinder contains precisely the sequences extending the finite word s; the empty word gives all Cantor space.

role: finite cylinder algebras and their union
notes: B-n contains all unions of length-n cylinders; the union is the clopen algebra of Cantor space and the direct limit of the inclusions.

role: explicit Cantor-to-Stone homeomorphism
notes: Using a Boolean isomorphism alpha from B to the cylinder algebra sends x to the elements b for which x belongs to alpha(b).

role: principal ultrafilter of a Boolean atom
notes: All elements above atom p; its singleton is the basic clopen hat-p and hence an isolated Stone point.

role: finitary Boolean-operator signature and arity
notes: A set of additional symbols with one finite arity per symbol; nullary symbols designate arbitrary Boolean elements.

role: abstract Boolean operator
notes: For positive arity preserves zero and finite joins in each coordinate; the conditions are vacuous for nullary symbols.

role: full complex algebra of a relational frame
notes: Power-set Boolean algebra with existential successor-tuple operations; the carrier may be the power set of the empty frame.

role: canonical relation of a finitary Boolean operator
notes: Every tuple of elements from the successor ultrafilters has its operator value in U; for arity zero this is a unary predicate.

role: ultrafilter frame of a Boolean algebra with operators
notes: The set of Boolean ultrafilters with all canonical operator relations.

role: canonical extension of a Boolean algebra with operators
notes: The full complex algebra of the ultrafilter frame; the Boolean embedding is dense and compact.

role: descriptive general frame of a Boolean algebra with operators
notes: The canonical relations on the Stone space together with precisely the basic-clopen image as admissible algebra.

role: admissible algebra of a general frame
notes: The carrier is the Boolean family of admissible sets closed under complex operators.

role: bounded morphism dual to a Boolean-operator homomorphism
notes: Inverse image on ultrafilters; its back condition follows from the simultaneous filter-extension lemma.

role: atom in a dense compact Boolean completion
notes: The meet of the images of all elements of an ultrafilter U; compactness makes it nonzero and density makes it an atom.

role: dual operations of a normal modal algebra
notes: Box preserves finite meets and one; diamond is its Boolean dual and preserves finite joins and zero.

role: normal-modal provable equivalence and its classes
notes: Equivalence means theoremhood of the biconditional in L and is a congruence for all formula constructors.

role: normal modal Lindenbaum algebra
notes: The formula algebra modulo provable equivalence; arbitrary valuations are handled with finite representative selections per formula.

role: algebra class validating a normal modal logic
notes: Normal modal algebras validating every member of L under all algebra valuations.

role: canonical general frame and its admissible sets
notes: Ultrafilters of the modal Lindenbaum algebra with the canonical relation and Stone clopens as admissible variable values.

role: underlying canonical relational frame
notes: Same worlds and relation as the canonical general frame; ordinary valuations may use every subset of X-L.

role: nonempty validating general-frame and ordinary-frame classes
notes: General frames validate L using admissible valuations; ordinary frames validate it using all subset valuations.

role: schematic extension of a modal logic to another variable set
notes: The least normal logic over Y containing all substituted instances of the original logic; used to state all-variable-set canonicity.

role: formulas for a finitary modal signature
notes: Finite Boolean formulas over X with one constructor of arity n-f for every symbol f in Lambda.

role: one-coordinate modal formula context
notes: All other arguments are fixed; used in theorem-level monotonicity and the normality and additivity axiom schemes.

role: Lindenbaum algebra of a finitary normal logic
notes: The formula quotient by L-provable equivalence with all finite-arity and nullary operators interpreted on classes.

role: Boolean-operator algebras validating a finitary logic
notes: All Lambda-BAOs validating L under every algebra valuation, including trivial algebras.

role: ultrafilters of the Boolean reduct
notes: The set of proper maximal Boolean filters, used as the canonical frame carrier of A.

role: descriptive canonical frame of a finitary normal logic
notes: Worlds are ultrafilters of F-Lambda-L; the relations are the full canonical operator relations and the admissible sets are Stone clopens.

role: descriptive general frames validating a finitary logic
notes: The nonempty descriptive Lambda-general frames validating every theorem under all admissible valuations.

role: canonical modal valuation
notes: Assigns each proposition variable the basic clopen determined by its formula class.

role: Priestley spectrum and its basic clopen upsets
notes: Proper prime lattice filters ordered by inclusion; hat-a consists of those containing a, and the topology also uses their complements.

role: lattice of clopen upsets
notes: Bounded distributive lattice for a Priestley space; carries the residual complement-of-downclosure operation for an Esakia space.

role: Priestley lattice representation
notes: Maps each lattice element to the clopen upset of prime filters containing it.

role: ordered-space reconstruction by prime filters
notes: Maps a point to its membership filter of clopen upsets; an order isomorphism and homeomorphism.

role: classical encoding of prime lattice filters
notes: The proposition p-a records membership of a; Pi-D imposes only bounded-lattice homomorphism laws to two, not Heyting implication preservation.

role: dependent choice for a prescribed start
notes: A serial relation on a nonempty set admits an infinite path beginning at a prescribed point; used in the arbitrary-poset dense-set lemma.

role: descending conditions and dense requirements
notes: Rasiowa-Sikorski construction has p-n-plus-one stronger than p-n and in D-n; its upward closure is generic for the given family.

role: Heyting residual on algebra elements
notes: The greatest c with c meet a below b; source notation a-arrow-b denotes this same operation when operands are algebra elements.

role: Heyting algebra of open subsets
notes: Finite meets are intersections and implication is the interior of the union of the first operand's complement with the second.

role: Heyting algebra of upsets of a preorder
notes: Implication holds at w when every larger point in the antecedent upset belongs to the consequent upset.

role: IPC Lindenbaum Heyting algebra
notes: Formula classes under mutual IPL derivability, ordered by one-premise derivability.

role: prime-filter order of a Heyting algebra
notes: All proper prime lattice filters ordered by inclusion; filters need not be maximal.

role: Heyting embedding into upsets of prime filters
notes: The set of prime filters containing a; the implication witness proves preservation of the residual.

role: downward closure and principal upset
notes: Order closures in a Priestley or Esakia space; the downclosure condition applies to every clopen subset.

role: Esakia order back condition
notes: Together with continuity and monotonicity this characterizes Esakia morphisms and ensures implication-preserving inverse images.

role: Heyting and Boolean classes in the common residual signature
notes: Classes of algebras for the intermediate-logic correspondence; HA here is not Heyting arithmetic from Part VII.

role: Lindenbaum Heyting algebra of an intermediate logic
notes: The quotient by L-provable biconditional, with formula implication inducing the algebraic residual.

role: order-reversing logic-variety assignments
notes: Heyting algebras validating L and formulas valid in V; inverse on the intervals IPC-to-CPL and BA-to-HA.

role: translation between residual terms and formulas
notes: Converts algebraic zero one and residual into bottom top and implication or conversely; identities correspond to biconditionals with value one.

role: categorical hom-set
notes: Arrows from object A to object B; local smallness places each such set in the fixed universe.

role: opposite category
notes: Reverses the arrows and composition order; a contravariant functor is an ordinary functor out of this category.

role: identity arrow and identity functor
notes: The subscript states the categorical level: an object for an arrow and a category for its identity functor.

role: family of natural transformations
notes: Component families in the containing ambient universe; Yoneda gives a small set of parameters for transformations from a representable.

role: adjunction and hom-set transposition
notes: Phi sends an arrow from F(A) to B to an arrow from A to G(B); its bijections are natural in both arguments.

role: unit and counit of an adjunction
notes: Natural transformations from the identity to GF and from FG to the identity; their components satisfy the two triangle identities.

role: product projections coproduct injections and pairing
notes: Domains and codomains distinguish projections from injections; pairing is the unique arrow with its specified product components.

role: product of categorical arrows
notes: The arrow with components f after the first projection and g after the second; respects identity and composition.

role: exponential object evaluation and transpose
notes: Evaluation has domain \(B^A\times A\); transposition sends \(f:X\times A\to B\) to the unique corresponding arrow \(X\to B^A\).

role: category of arrow-only typed contexts
notes: Objects are finite type lists and arrows are typed term tuples modulo componentwise beta-eta equality.

role: typed beta-eta equational consequence
notes: The equational metatheory includes alpha-renaming and typed beta and eta schemas; the registered reduction relation remains beta reduction.

role: typed simultaneous substitution and its action
notes: A tuple of Theta-terms with the types declared in Psi; substitutes into a Psi-term without resubstituting into inserted terms.

role: curried type and context exponential
notes: Right-associated arrows over Gamma's type list; the exponential list has one such curried type per component of Delta.

role: categorical interpretation of a context or term
notes: Context products begin with the chosen terminal object; a term denotes an arrow from its context object to its interpreted type.

role: named type interpreted type and context object
notes: The named base type denotes \(A\); \(A_T\) interprets the type \(T\), and \(P_\Gamma\) is the recursively chosen product with leading terminal factor.

role: named arrow terminal and pairing constants
notes: Closed constants in the expanded internal language; their declared applications denote the corresponding arrows and product pairing.

role: comparison constants for a named exponential
notes: Compare the base type naming \(B^A\) with the arrow type between the named types for \(A\) and \(B\); both unary interpretations are identities.

role: full true diagram and its equational theory
notes: Contains every true typed equation in every finite context of the named language; no effective enumeration is asserted.

role: recursive type comparison terms
notes: Closed inverse comparisons between T and the named type for its interpreted object; applications preserve denotation.

role: inverse context packing arrows
notes: Compare \(\Gamma\) with the singleton named context for \(P_\Gamma\); the packing term and its context arrow have different codomains.

role: internal context category evaluation and quasi-inverse
notes: Evaluation sends \(\Gamma\) to \(P_\Gamma\); \(J\) names objects and arrows, with \(EJ(A)=1\times A\) for the chosen product.

role: product and exponential comparison isomorphisms
notes: The product comparison uses interpreted block projections; the exponential comparison transposes interpreted evaluation after the inverse product comparison.

role: finite ordinals and the structural theory functor
notes: The identity-on-objects functor preserves finite products; a finite-set function \(m\to n\) selects an arrow \(n\to m\) in the theory.

role: chosen powers and tuples in a Lawvere theory
notes: The arrows \(p_i^n:n\to1\) exhibit \(n=1^n\), with \(p_0^1=1_1\); the empty tuple is the unique arrow \(n\to0\).

role: equations with explicit finite contexts
notes: Each triple asserts equality of its two terms under every assignment to the declared \(k\)-variable context.

role: all-carrier and nonempty-carrier equational categories
notes: Both use carriers in the fixed universe and all operation-preserving functions; the latter is the full subcategory with nonempty carrier.

role: equational congruence in a finite context
notes: The least family containing the stated equations and closed under operation compatibility and simultaneous substitutions between all finite contexts.

role: term theory of an equational presentation
notes: Its arrows are \(m\)-tuples of congruence classes of \(n\)-variable terms; composition is substitution and object \(0\) is terminal.

role: evaluation model and homomorphism transformation
notes: The model assigns \(A^n\) to \(n\) and evaluates term tuples; a homomorphism \(h\) gives components \(h^n\).

role: Lawvere models and the underlying-set functor
notes: Finite-product-preserving functors to Set and all natural transformations; \(U(M)=M(1)\) and \(U(\alpha)=\alpha_1\).

role: canonical model power comparison
notes: The bijection \(M(n)\to M(1)^n\) has coordinates \(M(p_i^n)\); the comparison at one uses singleton tuples.

role: one-component term and basic-operation arrows
notes: An \(n\)-variable term determines an arrow \(n\to1\); a symbol of arity \(k\) gives its basic term arrow \(k\to1\).

role: named equational presentation of a theory
notes: One operation symbol for each arrow to the generator; projection and substitution equations recover precisely the original arrows.

role: categorical evaluation of a named algebraic term
notes: An arrow \(n\to1\) in the given theory; substitution of terms is composition with their tuple of interpreted arrows.

role: isomorphism recovering a Lawvere theory
notes: Evaluation from the named term theory is identity on objects; \(\rho\) denotes this fixed isomorphism when transporting free models.

role: restriction of models and translation of named terms
notes: A theory morphism induces precomposition on models; its named-symbol translation commutes with the recovery isomorphisms.

role: representable finite free model and its generators
notes: The model \(R_n=T(n,-)\) is free on \(n\); its generator indexed by \(i\) is \(p_i^n:n\to1\).

role: semantic term congruence and free equational algebra
notes: The congruence requires equality under every evaluation into an all-carrier model; its quotient includes the empty term case.

role: free Lawvere-model functor and generator map
notes: The free model has values \(Q_X^n\) after the fixed theory isomorphism; the generator maps \(x\) to the singleton tuple \(([x])\).

role: predicate fibre and its bounds
notes: A small Heyting algebra of predicates in context object \(I\); its order is semantic entailment in that context.

role: category of Heyting algebras and homomorphisms
notes: Maps preserve both bounds, finite meets and joins, and Heyting implication; reindexing takes values in this category.

role: predicate reindexing along a context map
notes: For \(f:J\to I\), the contravariant functor sends predicates in \(I\) to predicates in \(J\), preserving every Heyting operation.

role: context projection and parameter substitution
notes: The projection \(I\times A\to I\) forgets one variable; a parameter map lifts to the displayed product substitution square.

role: projection quantifier adjoints
notes: The maps from \(P(I\times A)\) to \(P(I)\) are respectively left and right adjoints to projection reindexing.

role: internal equality predicate
notes: An element of \(P(A\times A)\) satisfying the full parameterized diagonal adjunction; no subobject representation is assumed.

role: maps for equality with parameters
notes: Use \((I\times A)\times A\): duplicate the final variable, select either copy with its parameters, or select the equality pair.

role: left adjoint for parameterized equality
notes: Defined by \(p^*\alpha\wedge r^*\delta_A\), with \(L_e\dashv e^*\); its full order adjunction gives equality elimination.

role: diagonal and exchange of an equality pair
notes: The arrows \(A\to A\times A\) and \(A\times A\to A\times A\) used to state reflexivity and symmetry.

role: internal inhabitance of a sort
notes: Equivalent by Beck--Chevalley to the corresponding condition in every parameter context; it implies reflection of predicate order, not of base-arrow equality.

role: powerset instance of a predicate fibre
notes: Boolean algebra of all subsets of a small set \(X\), including the one-element fibre for empty \(X\).

role: Boolean implication between subsets
notes: The subset \((X\setminus U)\cup V\) is the Heyting residual in the powerset fibre.

role: powerset quantifiers along an arbitrary function
notes: Direct image and the condition that the entire fibre belongs to the predicate; empty fibres satisfy the universal condition.

role: variable context and hypothesis list in Pitts's calculus
notes: The first is a finite list of distinct sorted variables; the second is a finite list of formulas in that context.

role: term formation and external term-equation judgments
notes: Formation is well-sortedness in the retained context; an equation is interpreted as equality of term arrows.

role: contextual predicate sequent
notes: The conjunction of the finite assumptions is below the conclusion in \(P(I_\Gamma)\); unused variable declarations are retained.

role: equality as a first-order formula
notes: Reindexes \(\delta_{A_\sigma}\) along the pair of term arrows; its truth need not reflect external equality of those arrows.

role: Pitts's propositional formula constructors
notes: Conjunction, implication, and falsity at the formula level; their denotations are the corresponding Heyting operations.

role: quantifiers on unary formula abstractions
notes: Pitts's printed quantifier notation; the body \(\varphi(x)\) is interpreted in the context extended by \(x:\sigma\).

role: metalevel formula abstraction and instantiation
notes: If \(\varphi=(x)e\), then \(\varphi(M)=e[M/x]\); this is binding notation, not an additional first-order connective.

role: interpreted finite variable context
notes: A chosen product starting with terminal object \(1\), extended by one sort object for each declaration.

role: contextual term and predicate interpretations
notes: A term denotes an arrow from \(I_\Gamma\) to its sort object; a formula denotes an element of \(P(I_\Gamma)\).

role: interpreted simultaneous term substitution
notes: Its components interpret one substituting term per variable of \(\Gamma\); formula substitution is reindexing along this map.

role: universe used for categorical size bounds
notes: May be the ambient collection of all sets; a set-sized relativization has the explicitly stated Grothendieck closures, with existence treated as a hypothesis.

role: local abbreviations for two contextual rule presentations
notes: The same theory and structural/equational basis, with either the natural-deduction logical rules or every direction of Pitts's adjoint bi-rules.

role: parameter-free equality bi-rule
notes: Both directions of Pitts's Remark 5.6.2; the displayed variable contexts have no hidden parameter prefix.

role: binary formula abstraction and simultaneous instantiation
notes: Application replaces the two displayed argument variables simultaneously in the body, avoiding capture.

role: presheaf category on a small base
notes: The category of functors \(\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{Set}\) and natural transformations, under the declared size convention.

role: representable presheaf and the Yoneda map
notes: The value at \(d\) is \(\mathcal C(d,c)\); an arrow between representing objects acts by postcomposition.

role: presheaf restriction and natural-transformation component
notes: For \(u:d\to c\), restriction maps \(X(c)\) to \(X(d)\); the component \(\alpha_c\) maps \(X(c)\) to \(Y(c)\).

role: ordered set of subpresheaves
notes: Restriction-stable families of component subsets; canonical images represent categorical subobjects and their factorization order.

role: constant initial and terminal presheaves
notes: These denote presheaves; numeric object names of a particular base category have their separately declared base-object role.

role: componentwise image and its factorization
notes: The natural map factors through its image by a componentwise surjection followed by an inclusion; a monic map is isomorphic to that inclusion.

role: subobject classifier and truth map
notes: Every monomorphism is a pullback along its unique characteristic arrow; the definition retains the full universal property.

role: component of a presheaf exponential
notes: The set \(\operatorname{Nat}(\mathrm y c\times X,Y)\), with restriction by precomposition; it need not be the pointwise external function set.

role: presheaf evaluation and transposition
notes: Evaluation uses the representing identity arrow; transposition uses every restriction of the parameter element.

role: sieves their restrictions and the maximal sieve
notes: A sieve is a set of arrows into \(c\) closed under precomposition; the maximal sieve contains the identity.

role: characteristic map of a subpresheaf
notes: At \(x\in X(c)\), it is the sieve of arrows \(u:d\to c\) whose restriction \(X(u)(x)\) belongs to \(A(d)\).

role: power object of a presheaf
notes: Here \(X\) is a presheaf and \(P(X)\) is an object of \(\widehat{\mathcal C}\), distinct from the earlier powerset-fibre usage for sets.

role: membership subobject of a power object
notes: The pullback of truth along evaluation; under stage classification membership tests whether \((1_c,x)\) lies in the represented subpresheaf.

role: restriction of a classified power-object element
notes: The pullback of \(S\subseteq\mathrm y c\times X\) along \(\mathrm y u\times1_X\).

role: subpresheaf determined by a relation and a parameter element
notes: For \(z\in Z(c)\), its component consists of pairs \((u,x)\) with \((Z(u)(z),x)\) in the original relation.

role: finite valuation domain and exact input-variable set
notes: In sec:p02-tseitin-transformation a valuation on W assigns precisely W; V is the set of variables occurring in the input formula, before auxiliary variables are chosen.

role: nonvariable occurrence positions
notes: Positions whose rooted subformula is not a propositional variable, including bottom occurrences; defined in def:p02-tseitin-construction.

role: fresh occurrence variable and auxiliary-variable set
notes: Distinct fresh variables are assigned to nonvariable occurrences; \(Z_\varphi\) is disjoint from the original variable set \(V\), and each \(z_a\) aliases a selected indexed propositional variable.

role: variable representative of a formula occurrence
notes: An original variable leaf represents itself; a nonvariable occurrence uses its fresh \(z_a\). The root representative is \(r_\epsilon\).

role: unrooted defining clause set
notes: All gate clauses in the Tseitin construction before the asserted root clause; every input assignment has a unique defining extension on \(V\cup Z_\varphi\).

notes: The defining clauses together with the unit clause containing the root representative; the root is necessary for the stated equisatisfiability theorem.

notes: Node blocks follow preorder and displayed row order, with the root clause last; repeated emissions remain in this list although \(S_\varphi\) is a set.

role: deterministic Tseitin CNF formula
notes: The inherited right-associated conjunction of the ordered emitted clause interpretations; equisatisfiable with the input, without general logical equivalence on the enlarged vocabulary.

role: Tseitin structural and encoding size parameters
notes: \(N\) counts input-tree positions, \(M\) its nonvariable positions, \(L\) the primitive input bit length; \(n_0\) counts bottom occurrences, \(n_1\) negations and \(n_2\) binary connectives in annex:p2.prop.tseitin-size.

role: normalized program serialization counts
notes: State count n and tape-alphabet size b are at least three; m=(n-2)b is the full row count and k=3+m the metadata-plus-row tuple length in def:p04-program-serialization.

notes: The b-bit bitmap A records normalized input-alphabet membership; bit zero excludes blank and bits one and two include the two numerical digits. Exponentiation in the numerical coding description is metatheoretic.

role: serialized five-field transition row
notes: The right-nested \(\operatorname{code}_5\) of source state, read symbol, target state, written symbol and direction, in exact lexicographic key order.

role: numerical transition-direction code
notes: Zero encodes L and one encodes R in the normalized program serialization; this is a numerical field rather than an empty-word or epsilon-binder symbol.

notes: E(s,t,j,v) uses one position; E2(s,t,a,b,v) flattens two positions. Their pairing indices have explicit arithmetic bounds and their unique values are at most s; each family tag has fixed positional arity.

notes: Metatheoretic beta lookups from def:p04-tagged-history-entry; each lookup inside a formula is replaced by a value variable and E or E2, never by a new arithmetic function symbol.

notes: Eliminable arithmetic formulas for strict comparison, non-strict comparison and membership in zero/one; matrix comparisons use marked bounded witnesses.

notes: H1(x,s) checks canonical input; H2(e,s) exact program/table data; H3(s) configurations and transitions; H4(s) accepting canonical output. Their conjunction defines Comp.

notes: P5 unpacks a right-nested five-field tuple; R5 extracts row i from description position 3+i. Validity and field ranges require H2 and i<m; a padding value alone is not a transition.

notes: Bounded H3 helpers enforce state/head/symbol ranges and tape prefixes, the canonical initial tape, and both head moves with exactly one overwritten cell and all other columns preserved.

notes: Bounded H4 helpers link each output bit to its normalized final-tape symbol and verify the complete binary prefix recurrence.
